# Images of the Druid test stack (the "Druid Tests" job in main.yml), mirrored from Docker Hub
# to ghcr.io/kenstott/calcite so the job does not depend on Docker Hub's anonymous pull quota.
#
#   <name>  <upstream image, pinned by digest>
#
# The mirror is ghcr.io/kenstott/calcite/ci-<name>@<the same digest>: mirror-ci-images.yml
# copies each image with its digest preserved. To move to a newer upstream image, change the
# digest here and start that workflow; the Druid job then pulls the new digest.
#
# postgres  was postgres:latest   as pushed 2026-10-07 (multi-platform index)
# zookeeper was zookeeper:3.5     as pushed 2023-02-01 (multi-platform index)
# druid     was apache/druid:0.17.1 as pushed 2020-03-31 (linux/amd64 manifest)
